sentence: Please put the bookcase in the corner of the room.
synonym: place the bookcase in the corner
synonymNote: place表示放置，与put意思相同，位置描述一致

distractors.word: move the bookcase to the wall
distractors.note: to the wall是靠墙，不是放在角落里

distractors.word: put the bookcase near the door
distractors.note: near the door是门旁边，位置不同

distractors.word: hang the bookcase in the corner
distractors.note: hang表示悬挂，书柜通常不悬挂
